description: 3-stage TOCTOU race condition in Stripe webhook processing: (1) implement synchronous webhook handler with order tracking and fulfillment, (2) add idempotency guard to prevent duplicate processing on retries, (3) move fulfillment to background thread for p99 latency — idempotency check reads 'pending' in main thread while status is only set to 'fulfilled' after slow work in background thread. Concurrent retries both pass the check, both spawn threads, causing double fulfillment.
